title: From one-off prompts to an AI system that saves you hours

say: From one-off prompts to an AI system that saves you hours.
This is the video for module one of AI Productivity Systems.

Most people use AI only when they remember it is there. They type a quick question, copy the answer, and next week they start again from nothing, explaining their organisation and style all over again.

panel.heading: Occasional use versus a system
items: Stop starting from nothing every week
Build the five parts of a system
Decide who does each step: you, AI or a tool
Build a context store the AI can use

say: A system is a small set of habits, files and checks around the AI tool, so good results come out every week and mistakes are caught before anyone else sees them.

say: First, capture. One notes app, or one WhatsApp chat with yourself, where ideas and requests land.

panel.heading: Every system has five parts
items: Capture: one place where everything lands
Context store: what the AI needs to know
Routines: repeatable steps with a fixed trigger
Review gate: check names, numbers, dates, tone
Log and improve: what each run cost and saved

Setup: about 3 hours, repaid in under three weeks

panel.rule: Time the task the old way first, at least twice.

say: Can AI do this task? The honest answer is usually partly. A task is a chain of steps, so write them in order and give each one a role.

panel.heading: Give every step one of four roles
items: Me only: judgement, money, private records
AI drafts, I edit
AI checks, I decide
Tool or template: formulas and fixed layouts

say: Me only is for steps that need your judgement, approving money, or private member records.

panel.heading: Give every step one of four roles
items: Me only: judgement, money, private records
AI drafts, I edit
AI checks, I decide
Tool or template: formulas and fixed layouts

say: AI drafts, I edit, means AI writes a first version and you correct and own it. AI checks, I decide, means you write and AI reviews.

panel.heading: Give every step one of four roles
items: Me only: judgement, money, private records
AI drafts, I edit
AI checks, I decide
Tool or template: formulas and fixed layouts

say: And some steps need no AI at all. Chat assistants can make counting mistakes while sounding confident, so totals belong in a spreadsheet formula like SUM or COUNTIF.

Total: 249 minutes down to 160

say: Start with tasks that repeat often and need little judgement. Each improvement pays back many times, and mistakes are easy to spot.

panel.heading: Which tasks get a routine first?

say: Rare tasks that need a lot of judgement stay in your own hands. And removing a task nobody reads saves more time than any routine.

panel.heading: Which tasks get a routine first?

say: An AI assistant knows nothing about you. So prepare a context store once and reuse it. A short context file, templates, good examples, and a dated facts sheet with correct names, venues and dates.

Check your tool's limits. On the free ChatGPT plan, custom instructions allow up to 1,500 characters. Halima's draft had 2,340, so she moved her organisation history into a project file and trimmed to 1,420.

panel.heading: Four layers of your context store
items: Context file: role, audiences, tone, words, formats
Templates: the shape of recurring outputs
Examples: two or three past outputs you liked
Reference facts: a dated facts sheet

say: Add a working rule: if information is missing, ask me rather than guessing.

panel.heading: What goes in, what stays out

say: Keep personal data out. Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023 gives people rights over their data, so use first names or roles. Keep a master copy outside the AI tool, and review your facts sheet monthly.

panel.heading: What goes in, what stays out

say: To remember. A system is habits, files and checks around the tool. Time your work before and after. Give every step a role. Let formulas do the counting. And keep personal data out of your context store.

panel.heading: Remember
items: A system is habits, files and checks, not the tool
Time tasks before and after, including checking
Design at the level of steps, with four roles
Calculations belong in spreadsheet formulas
Personal data never goes into the store

say: Now time three of your recurring tasks, redesign one of them step by step, and build your context store.
